title: 第4350章 至尊剑塔异变第4349章 左闵的直觉
content_zh:
“怎么回事，我怎么突然有种莫名不安感？”左闵神情不安，这种古怪的感觉实在太过突兀。
而且……
作为半步神王，直觉往往都是十分敏锐的。
突然有这种感觉，那么便也说明着自己可能有危险。
“他们两个似乎没有这种感觉。”左闵下意识看向赵烈川和詹泽，只看到两人仍旧目光炯炯盯着四周，不由松了口气。
“在此地……唯一的危险就是那个叫做秦浩的小子，此人不过顶阶法则神君而已，不对……”
左闵心中思忖，可想到这里，他突然脸色微变，“这么久过去，那秦浩还是顶阶法则神君？”
如此问题，陡然便在左闵脑海中浮现而出，不由让他心中猛地发紧了一下。
道源神君！
秦浩很有可能已经突破道源神君！
开玩笑，秦浩在此地显然是在闭关苦修的，而前后三十多年，修为已然从初阶法则神君，晋升为顶阶法则神君。
这一点。
之前秦浩第二次出现的时候，就已经证实。
为此他们三人还感到非常震惊和不可思议。
“难道让我有那莫名不安感的，便是秦浩？”左闵脸色变幻，这么久过去，他们早已知晓秦浩的名字和身份。
荒尘浊域，天地宫，剑武神君，秦浩！
“如果真是如此，恐怕要小心了。”左闵再次看向赵烈川和詹泽，两人神情没有变化。
见此一幕，左闵不由犹豫了下，传音道：“二位，有个事情需要和你们商议一下。”
左闵说这番话的时候，神情是无比郑重的，话语中隐隐还带着一丝不安，没办法，刚才心中突然浮现而出的心悸、不安感……
让他实在无法置之不顾。

“左兄，何事？”突然听到左闵的话，詹泽不由怔了下，诧异看向左闵。
赵烈川也是眼中闪过一抹讶异，传音道：“左兄，你莫非是发现了什么？”
“那倒没有……”左闵摇摇头，传音道，“你们想过一个问题没有，那秦浩之前短短三十多年，便从初阶法则神君晋升顶阶法则神君……”
“那么……”
“现在，有没有可能晋升道源神君？”
左闵神情郑重，尤其想到刚才心中的不安，语气更是带着一丝忐忑和紧张。
“道源神君？”
赵烈川和詹泽闻言再次一怔，两人彼此对视一眼，旋即嗤笑一声，赵烈川摇头道：“左兄，你太小心了，我承认那小子确实有些天赋……”
“短短时间，竟是能晋升顶阶法则神君，实力也极其不俗，可是终究只是法则神君而已。”
说到这里，赵烈川顿了顿，继续道：“就算他掌握道意，真的在短短十数年内突破道源神君，可那又如何，难道我们三人同时出手，还对付不了他一个道源神君？”
说到这里，赵烈川冷笑一声，眼中闪过一抹不屑，浑然没有将秦浩当成一回事。
事实也是如此。
如果不是秦浩手中那疑似宝物之物，他们就更加不重视秦浩，或者从一开始……
秦浩出现的时候，他们便已然将秦浩成功斩杀。
至于秦浩的修为……
对他们来说，法则神君和道源神君并没有什么区别，都只是神君罢了。
他们三人虽说尚未真正凝聚神格，晋升下位神王，可要说实力，比之顶阶道源神君强大太多。
毫不夸张的说。
他们三人中任何一人，都足以同时对付好几个顶阶道源神君。
差距之大，可想而知。
content_en:
"What's going on? Why do I suddenly feel inexplicable uneasiness?" Zuo Min looked uneasy. This strange feeling was too sudden.
And...
As a half-step god king, his intuition is often very keen.
If you suddenly feel this way, it means that you may be in danger.
"The two of them don't seem to have this feeling." Zuo Min subconsciously looked at Zhao Liechuan and Zhan Ze, only to see that they were still staring at the surroundings with bright eyes, and couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief.
"Here... the only danger is the boy named Qin Hao. This person is just the top-level Law God Lord, no..."
Zuo Min was thinking in his heart, but when he thought of this, his expression suddenly changed slightly, "After all this time, is Qin Hao still the top-level Law God?"
Such a question suddenly appeared in Zuo Min's mind, and he couldn't help but feel tense in his heart.
Daoyuan Shenjun!
Qin Hao is very likely to have broken through to the Principle of God!
Just kidding, Qin Hao was obviously practicing hard in seclusion here, and for more than thirty years, his cultivation level has been promoted from the low-level law god king to the top-level law god king.
at this point.
Qin Hao had already confirmed it when he appeared for the second time.
The three of them were very shocked and incredulous about this.
"Could it be that Qin Hao is the one who makes me feel so inexplicably uneasy?" Zuo Min's expression changed. After so long, they already knew Qin Hao's name and identity.
In the turbid wasteland, the Palace of Heaven and Earth, the Sword and Martial God Lord, Qin Hao!
"If that's the case, I'm afraid you have to be careful." Zuo Min looked at Zhao Liechuan and Zhan Ze again, their expressions did not change.
Seeing this scene, Zuo Min couldn't help but hesitate and said via voice message: "You two, there is something I need to discuss with you."
When Zuo Min said these words, his expression was extremely solemn, and there was a hint of uneasiness in his words. He couldn't help it, but the palpitations and uneasiness that suddenly appeared in his heart just now...
He really couldn't ignore it.
"Brother Zuo, what's the matter?" Suddenly hearing Zuo Min's words, Zhan Ze couldn't help but startled and looked at Zuo Min in surprise.
Zhao Liechuan also had a flash of surprise in his eyes, and said via voice transmission: "Brother Zuo, have you discovered something?"
"That's not true..." Zuo Min shook his head and said through a message, "Have you ever thought about this question? In just over thirty years ago, Qin Hao was promoted from a low-level law god to a top-level law god..."
"So..."
"Now, is it possible to be promoted to the Lord of Principle Source?"
Zuo Min looked solemn, especially thinking of the uneasiness in his heart just now, and his tone was even more uneasy and nervous.
"Principal Lord Daoyuan?"
Zhao Liechuan and Zhan Ze were startled again when they heard this. They looked at each other and immediately sneered. Zhao Liechuan shook his head and said: "Brother Zuo, you are too careful. I admit that that kid does have some talent..."
"In a short period of time, he was able to be promoted to the top level Law God Lord, and his strength is extremely impressive, but in the end he is just a Law God Lord."
Having said this, Zhao Liechuan paused and continued: "Even if he masters the will of the Tao and really breaks through the Divine Lord of the Principle Source in just a dozen years, so what? Could it be that if the three of us attack at the same time, we still can't deal with him as a Divine Lord of the Principle Source?"
Having said this, Zhao Liechuan sneered, with a flash of disdain in his eyes, not taking Qin Hao seriously at all.
This is also true.
If it weren't for the suspected treasure in Qin Hao's hand, they would have paid even less attention to Qin Hao, or maybe from the beginning...
When Qin Hao appeared, they had successfully killed Qin Hao.
As for Qin Hao’s cultivation...
To them, there is no difference between the Divine Lord of Laws and the Divine Lord of Principle, they are both just Divine Lords.
Although the three of them have not yet truly condensed their divine personality and been promoted to the lower level God King, they can be said to be much stronger than the top-level Principle God King.
Quite literally.
Any one of the three of them is enough to deal with several top-level Principle God Lords at the same time.
It is conceivable that the gap is huge.
